about: Recorded by record_expectations.py --absence from the search as it was at recording time. Every question runs once per set of reformulations.json with --exhaustive at --limit 12, on one release loaded with load(exhaustive=True, include_sources=True). negatives lists, per set, the seven questions about topics the wiki does not hold: complete must stay true with zero word-form hits, and every heuristic hit, identified within its file by path, kind and line, must be one recorded here with a reason, the judgment of a person who read the passage (a newly recorded hit carries the unjudged marker until then). complete_floor and claims_returned_floor are minimums per set: the number of complete checks, and the number of claim-heavy questions whose answering claim is printed in results or reformulation_results or returned as an exhaustive hit. tests/test_search_quality.py (AbsenceGate) also fails when a required page of an answerable question is in none of results, reformulation_results and the returned exhaustive_hits unless accepted lists it (set, id, path, reason), when an answering claim is not reachable (printed, a hit, or on a printed page with withheld claims), when a navigation file appears as a hit page, or when the exhaustive call changes anything the same call with include_sources returns. Caveats: the sets come from the same model family that is evaluated with them, so the numbers are optimistic; they are a regression gate, never a tuning target, and are never edited to make the gate pass. Changing this file is a deliberate act: state the change and its reason in the commit message.
